1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising:
- obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor;
- assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor;
- assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor;
- determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor; and
- generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the processor, wherein the traffic message is transmitted to a navigation system device.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a server processor.

25. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements comprising:
- generating a message having an advertising reference code using a processor; and
- providing the message for broadcast to navigation systems using the processor, wherein the advertising reference code comprises a substantially unique code that identifies at least a portion of an advertisement stored and displayed on a recipient device of the message, and wherein the message is transmitted to a navigation system device.

26. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 25 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a server processor.

27. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements via a traffic channel comprising:
- generating a message having advertisements using a processor; and
- serially transmitting the message for broadcast to navigation systems via the traffic channel using the processor, wherein the message is transmitted to a navigation system device.

28. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 27 is implemented at server side of a traffic service network using a server processor.

29. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising:
- receiving a message from a traffic supplier using a processor, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code;
- assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code using the processor; and
- presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code using a display device coupled to the processor.

30. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 29 is implemented at client side of a traffic service network using a client processor.
